header.act: ACT II — THE ROAD TO THE TISZA
player.speaker: Front Commissar
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: András Fekete
line.reaction-briliant.text: The rear guard held beyond the planned departure hour. We used the extra time to clear the trains. I've brought the arrivals for the staff to check.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: András Fekete
line.reaction-tactical.text: We got the formations out, but the line broke before all the transport cleared. I'll need replacements for the equipment left behind. The crews are already asking when.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: András Fekete
line.reaction-victory.text: The withdrawal was carried out in order. The formations are intact, which is more than the staff expected to be able to report.
line.callback-railway-rearguard.speaker: András Fekete
line.callback-railway-rearguard.text: More guns and wounded men reached us because you held the station. I can show Böhm the wagon returns if he still thinks we stayed too long.
line.callback-mobile-rearguard.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.callback-mobile-rearguard.text: You trusted my withdrawal times. The formations got out, but Fekete lost wagons he can't replace. I owe him an answer about those.
line.nyiregyhaza-platform.speaker: András Fekete
line.nyiregyhaza-platform.text: I have ammunition stacked at Nyíregyháza and no locomotive free to take it. The wounded are climbing onto wagons before they stop. Which headquarters controls the westbound traffic? I've been given three maps.
line.stromfeld-arrives.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-arrives.text: Give me the maps. I'll issue one route order. Units are retreating separately and reporting to whichever telephone answers. We cannot hold all these towns, but we must keep Tokaj open until the formations cross the Tisza.
line.bohm-question.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.bohm-question.text: The men are tired and every abandoned wagon starts another betrayal story. They need an order we can carry out. Strike one Romanian pincer to reopen the road, or move the transport behind successive rear guards?
Strike one pincer hard enough to reopen the road, then disengage before the second can arrive.
Gain a prestige award and experience for every core formation, but forgo full resupply and the additional transport column.
line.bohm-question.choice.phased-retreat: Build successive rear-guard lines and move the transport first. The army must reach the Tisza intact.
Fully resupply every core formation and gain a transport column, but forgo the counterstroke's prestige and core-wide experience.
line.stromfeld-counterstroke.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-counterstroke.text: Concentrate for a short attack. When the road opens, disengage. Put that in the battalion orders; I don't want anyone pursuing after we've got what we need.
line.fekete-retreat.speaker: András Fekete
line.fekete-retreat.text: I will send ammunition and wounded men toward Tokaj first. Once the last train leaves, the bridges and sidings can be denied to the enemy.
line.bohm-final.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.bohm-final.text: Get headquarters through Tokaj before the pincers meet. Keep officers with the guns and wagons. The men need to see that someone still knows where they're going.
